llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple classic scam characteristics: 1) Unusually low prices and urgency tactics (hot sale, free shipping); 2) Claims to sell branded products without proof of distribution rights; 3) Vague and generic privacy policy with no concrete company information; 4) Inaccessible contact page — no legitimate business phone, address, or email; 5) Recently registered domain with no verifiable business links; 6) SSL certificate issues indicating poor security; 7) No trace of legitimate reputation or review history online. These combined factors strongly indicate that this is a fake online shopping scam website.
